signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 2 US offices
1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Launch an agentic planning product that helps leaders compare staffing scenarios, understand cost and service tradeoffs, and decide when to hire or outsource.
Improve forecasting and scheduling so customers can predict support demand and put the right people in place across skills, locations, and working hours.
Help customers manage outsourced support teams, from assigning work to tracking whether vendors deliver the staffing and performance they committed to.
Connect planning decisions to day-to-day schedules, using actual demand, costs, and performance to help customers adjust their plans over time.
Work directly with customers and go-to-market teams to validate new capabilities, bring the planning product to market, and drive adoption and revenue.
Own the product vision and roadmap for agentic automation, connecting customer needs to measurable business outcomes.
Define the controls, visibility, and evaluations that let customers trust autonomous decisions and involve a person when needed.
Work directly with customers to test the product in live operations, measure its impact, and drive adoption.
Partner with go-to-market teams on packaging, pricing, and launch, and define the metrics that connect automated work to customer value and revenue.
